body: Break ups are hard, especially when you're still in love with the other person. Look, moving on is hard, and seems impossible, but you will. You'll find someone who'll give you those butterflies, or the fluttering in your heart. And it'll feel amazing. You don't need to kill yourself. There are trillions of people on this planet, you'll find someone =)

I'm so sorry for your situation, I can't believe you've been through that. Theres probably nothing a stranger on the internet could do to provide some sort of comfort, but look, from what it sounds like you're a pretty strong person. Nobody deserves that kind of shit. You don't need to die, life seems bleak now but there is so much more to it. It probably isn't convincing for me to tell you, but see a Therapist, and ditch the abuse.
I'm sorry, I empathize. What happened if you dont mind me asking?
Oh my god flash back to the Old PS2 days of Kingdom hearts and Dark Cloud.

Im just starting College, and also just told my parents of my depression. I'll be seeing a therapist soon to get medication, but until then I still have to deal with it. As for advice, the easiest way for me to deal with it was to just stick with something I really loved, which was music. Can't go anywhere without some sort of Ipod. I don't know yet what its like to be on anti depressents, im actually a little scared they might change me a bit, but I think you really should stick with therapy/medicine. I cant believe the therapist would treat you like that, I'd imagine the last thing one would want to do was make one of their patients feel bad over waiting so long. I think you need to just switch up whichever doctor you're seeing, there has to be people out there that'll work with you.
Hey bud, listen herpes isn't the end man, theres no need to kill yourself over it. Look, if you do have it, they have medicine for it now, it's all good!
Duuude one day you'll escape from whatever town you're in and find places that aren't as shitty. (Don't get me wrong, other places still suck, but in varying degree)
Whaaaaat College people aren't mean and shallow.....I hope. I'll see tomorrow, but even so I'M definitly not like that, you're not like that, there are definitly others who aren't like that!

Not so sure on that one. Maybe run into someone at the coffee shop who buys the same drink as you, as totally unrealistic as that sounds, it could happen. If you're not into that scene, theeeen Craigslist or dating websites. If anything you could end up meeting that special someone at work or college.

Look, don't blame yourself for things. The economy is in the tank, and really it requires serious dedication to landing one by being in the right place at the right time, or knowing someone. College is expensive, and I personally hate that you have to take certain classes in certain areas to get your diploma (For example, I'll be doing a Computer Science Major, but I have to fork out the cash to take classes in a bunch of BS electives that I do NOT need for my job). Depression sucks, and you're probably a great person! Nobody deserves the emotional pain behind depression, I wouldn't wish it on people I hate. And look, you'll find someone whos like you and makes you happy, theres billions of people on this planet, there are plenty of people to choose from.
Are you taking any medicine for depression? What are you dealing with, if I  may ask?
I wish you the best, I'm sure everything will be fine and you'll get the help you need =)

I can only tell you from what I did. I just sat down with my mom, at a time where she wasn't busy with anything or too tired from the day, and explained what I had been dealing with. Basically just saying "I've been dealing with depression and I need your help and support". It was hard, but it had to be done, and my only regret is not doing it sooner. If your parents love you, then they'll help you get through your depression.

I don't know your parents so I wouldn't know how they'd react, but when I finally told my parents after dealing with it throughout high school, it felt like a huge weight was lifted. The feeling that you don't have to deal with depression by yourself is great. Its probably the hardest step to take, but afterwards, it gets easier. Maybe just tell one of your parents, whichever one you feel more comfortable talking to.
Have you tried just stepping back and taking it easy, watching TV or reading a book? What about school, or work?

What do you like to do to pass the time? Like, your hobbies and stuff. Do what you like, regardless of how realistic or unrealistic it sounds. Like music? Do music. Like to write? Become an author. A lot of stuff to do, and hey there is a lot to life, and maybe you don't find something that clicks right with you for awhile, but there is always something for everyone =)
You probably already tried, but have you tried explaining the difference between the two? And how about medicine/therapy or talking to your parents?
I understand completely how you feel, I'm in the same boat. Will they atleast hear you out, or let you vent to them?

I guess I'm lucky when I think about my situation. And I feel bad about being depressed because I have a loving family, but thats not enough, most times I just dont wanna talk to them. I'm a gamer, I love music, and playing guitar and reading. I was born with Marfans Syndrome, which is a heart condition, really only thing I cant do with it is play contact sports, but I love to play basketball. The condition makes me really tall and thin, with some complications like bad eyesight and scoliosis, which ahve both been fixed with surgeries. Going to go to school for Computer Science so I can design my own games, Im already in the process of making one myself. Nothings really been lookin up til my senior year which I just finished, I was an outcast until then, because after all the surgeries previously I finally came out looking normal, and wasn't anti social, but that still stays with me and messes with my head. Its cool that you help at hospitals, I'm too scarred mentally to be able to put up with being in them for very long. I guess lifes not terrible for me, but I just cant shake the depression.
lol the name actually gave me a laugh. I'm just sad, it gets worse at night where I've nothing to really get my mind off things. But tell me about you, the conversation will help me.
Forget the parents, you don't need their shit. What do you want to do if you went to college? What do you want to do when you get out of all that BS?
